prompt: Two figures, both fully visible head to knee, the same size, in a dim stone crypt. On the right, a gaunt priest in tattered black robes with a bone-pale shaved head stands in side profile, one clawed hand outstretched toward the left. On the left, a kneeling man in plain grey tunic collapses, his greyish drained but still-human flesh sagging, mouth open in agony. A vivid ribbon of crimson blood-mist streams out of the kneeling victim chest, arcing across the gap and into the priest open palm. The only source of light is the deep red glow of the blood ribbon. The background is a wall of dark wet stone blocks.
